Judge whether the copy matches the brand voice.
Voice guidelines: ['Write plainly and specifically; name the feature and what it does.', "Lead with the customer's trip, not the product's ego.", 'Prefer concrete numbers (weight, capacity, ratings) over adjectives.', "Respect the reader's experience; assume they know the outdoors.", 'Be honest about limits — say what the gear is not built for.', 'One clear call to action per message.']

Subject: Your Winter Guide — Plus 30% Off Everything This Week
Preview: Gear up for cold-weather trips. Everything in the store is 30% off this week.
Body: Winter travel has its own rhythm — shorter days, heavier packs, decisions that matter more when the temperature drops. This week's guide is for the trips you're already planning.

We've pulled together what works in the cold: layering systems that manage moisture before it becomes a problem, insulation rated for the conditions you're actually heading into, and shelter that holds up when the wind picks up after dark.

No fluff. If a piece of gear has a limit, we'll name it. If it's built for a specific temperature range or terrain type, that's what we'll tell you.

This week only, everything is 30% off — no exceptions. That includes cold-weather base layers, mid-layers, shells, sleep systems, and accessories. If it's in the store, the discount applies.

Take the time to read through the guide, match the gear to your route, and head out with what you need — nothing more.
Score 0-1; a score below 0.75 is a fail.
Respond with ONLY a JSON object, no prose or code fences. Reason first, then decide — the verdict must follow from the reasoning. Use exactly this key order: {"reasoning": "<one sentence>", "evidence": ["<short quote or fact>", ...], "score": <float 0-1>, "verdict": "pass"|"fail"}.
